text: 2026年10月19日，中国人民银行行长潘功胜会见了桥水投资公司创始人瑞·达利欧，双方围绕全球经济金融形势、中国宏观经济政策等议题进行了交流。
text_en: On October 19, 2026, PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng met with Ray Dalio, founder of Bridgewater Associates, and the two sides exchanged views on topics including the global economic and financial situation and China's macroeconomic policies.
